channel.title: Agent CLI Updates
channel.description: Signed Agent CLI macOS app updates.

item.description:
## macOS installed-CLI fix
When **Use my installed agent-cli** is enabled, the app now respects your existing speech-provider and server configuration without automatically starting a local voice service or warming a local speech model. This fixes unnecessary model loading and delays during startup and recording for users with a remote server or another provider.
The app still checks that your installed CLI is available. Bundled-runtime voice setup keeps its existing behavior.
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.108.1...v0.108.2

## macOS voice setup fixes
- Show the actual first-use setup stage, including runtime installation, voice-service startup, and speech-model preparation, with elapsed time and a clear “Not recording” label. - Cancel a pending hold-to-transcribe recording when you release the shortcut before setup finishes. Setup continues in the background, and the app tells you when it is ready to try again. - Move the setup card and recording/transcribing indicator by dragging them, or minimize them to the menu bar. Restore them with **Show Voice Setup…** or **Show Voice Activity…**; progress updates and recording attempts preserve minimized state. - Report voice-service port conflicts promptly and avoid saving a ready marker before startup checks succeed. - Prepare the model again after failed setup or a service reinstall. Unrelated commands no longer replace failed voice setup with a misleading ready message.
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.108.0...v0.108.1

## macOS settings and permissions
Agent CLI's macOS app now has a resizable settings window with a sidebar for General, Recording, Shortcuts, Permissions, and Advanced. Recording options, model settings, keyboard shortcuts, and diagnostics are easier to find, with help beside the controls it explains.
A dedicated Permissions page shows microphone, Accessibility, and notification access. Permission checks are silent; requests happen when you choose them. Starting a recording without microphone access opens setup first. Denied access opens the relevant System Settings page, and status refreshes when you return. Notifications remain optional, and clipboard recording works without Accessibility.
Accessibility recovery now requires confirmation, is unavailable during active work, and reopens setup after restart. Existing preferences and shortcuts are preserved.
## Other changes
- Update KeyboardShortcuts to 1.17.0. - Update CI dependencies and the macOS installation guide.
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.107.1...v0.108.0

## Bug fixes
- **Keep diagnostics out of dictated text.** The macOS app now captures stdout and stderr separately, so audio-shutdown warnings no longer appear before a successful transcription. Nonempty stdout is pasted on its own. (#652) - **Keep errors available when no text is returned.** If stdout is empty, the app pastes stderr instead while preserving the failure notification. If both streams are empty, it reports the missing transcript without pasting anything. (#652) - Drain stderr concurrently to avoid blocking on verbose diagnostics, and keep shell startup warnings out of executable-path discovery. (#652)
## Maintenance
- Update Sparkle to 2.9.6. (#631) - Update the Whisper and TTS CUDA container bases to 12.9.2. (#485) - Update setup-uv to v10, docker/login-action to v4.5.2, and release-drafter to v7.7.0. (#633, #628, #629)
The audio-shutdown timeout itself is unchanged; this release corrects how its diagnostic output is handled.
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.107.0...v0.107.1

## Features
- **See transcription progress after releasing the key.** The macOS overlay stays visible with a blue spinner and “Transcribing…” label until the request completes or fails. A separate MM:SS timer shows elapsed transcription time, starting from zero when processing begins. (#651) - **A fuller recording waveform.** The recording timer sits closer to the left edge, and wider, taller waveform bars fill the remaining pill space. (#651)
## Bug fixes
- Keep the transcription pill compact after live-preview recordings, and restore the preview layout if a failed toggle-stop request returns to recording. (#651) - Preserve overlay visibility across overlapping recording and transcription activity. Ignore duplicate recording-completion events so they cannot stop another active recording indicator. (#651)
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.106.0...v0.107.0

## Features
- **Know when recording really starts.** The macOS overlay now shows an amber “Connecting…” indicator while capture starts, then a green waveform once audio arrives. If audio samples stop arriving, it switches to “Waiting for audio…”. Silence still counts as active recording. (#650) - **See elapsed recording time.** A compact MM:SS timer sits beside the waveform. It starts with the first audio sample, excludes connection delay, and resets for each recording. (#650)
## Fixes
- **No more false success for empty transcriptions.** Empty or whitespace-only results now produce a clear error with recovery guidance instead of “Transcription Finished” and an empty paste. The macOS check also covers older user-installed CLI versions. (#649) - **Keep recognized speech when cleanup fails.** If LLM cleanup returns blank text, the CLI preserves the raw transcription on the clipboard and identifies cleanup as the failed step. Empty speech-recognition results leave the clipboard unchanged. (#649)
## Maintenance
- Update Docker build actions and Codecov integration. (#645, #646, #647, #648)
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.105.2...v0.106.0

## Bug fixes
- Accept M4A, OGG, MP3, and other FFmpeg-supported uploads in the Transformers ASR backend. Transformers and NeMo now share audio preparation, with invalid input reported as HTTP 400. (#644) - Normalize stereo, non-16-bit, and non-16 kHz WAV uploads before WAV-only ASR backends read them, preventing incorrect sample interpretation. Standard 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV uploads pass through unchanged. (#644) - Stop FFmpeg conversions when requests are cancelled or conversion times out, then clean up temporary files. Faster-whisper retains native compressed-audio decoding without a system FFmpeg dependency. (#644)
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.105.1...v0.105.2

## Bug fixes
- Release unused CUDA cache after each transcription in the transformers ASR backend, keeping model weights loaded for the next request. Long recordings no longer leave their peak temporary GPU allocation reserved throughout the idle timeout. In a Qwen3-ASR test, idle process VRAM dropped from 10.89 GiB to 4.13 GiB. (#642) - Clear temporary tensor references held by failed-request tracebacks, including chained and grouped exceptions, before releasing CUDA cache. CPU and MPS behavior is unchanged. (#642)
**Full changelog:** https://github.com/basnijholt/agent-cli/compare/v0.105.0...v0.105.1

## What’s Changed
* Prevent Qwen long-audio truncation (#641) @basnijholt * Publish diarization Docker image (#640) @basnijholt

## What’s Changed
* Add speaker diarization API and Docker image (#639) @basnijholt * Fix Docker image publishing and runtime extras (#638) @basnijholt * ⬆️ Update actions/deploy-pages action to v5.0.1 (#637) [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/apps/renovate) * ⬆️ Update docker/setup-buildx-action action to v4.3.0 (#635) [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/apps/renovate)
